resources.string: Shows a floating hang-up button during calls
Puts a large floating End Call button on the screen whenever a call is running, so you can hang up from any screen. Also lets you end a call by pressing volume-down twice.
Detects when a call starts and ends. This is what keeps battery use at zero.
Draws the floating button and enables the volume-down shortcut.
Needed to detect and end normal cellular calls.
Show the button, then press and hold it to drag it where you want. It snaps to the nearest edge and remembers the spot.
